reviews.author: Samantha Watson
reviews.text:
Hired this beautiful caravan for my family holiday. Lakeland Touring could not have been any nicer or helpful. The caravan itself was lovely clean and tidy. Everything we needed and more. And we will definitely be using them again for our next adventure.
Couldn’t be any happier.

reviews.text:
